_about: Thomas Hobbes (1588-1679): The English Works of Thomas Hobbes of Malmesbury, ed. Sir William Molesworth (London: John Bohn, 1839-1845, 11 vols.), vols. 1-7, clean Gutenberg. Vol. 1 is the English Elements of Philosophy (De Corpore). Leviathan is also on the Adler shelf (PG 3207) in a different edition. Vols. 8-11 (the Thucydides and Homer translations, and the index) are not on Gutenberg; Hobbes's Thucydides and Homer are held on the thucydides and homer shelves, so Molesworth's vols. 8-11 are not wanted. No uids minted.
